use_when.text: Label which password is needed, such as current, new or confirm password.
Use PasswordField for passwords, PINs or other secrets.
Use password visibility controls for PasswordField when appropriate.
Use PasswordField when the value must be hidden while typing.

dont_use_when.text: Don’t reveal the password by default or make the visibility control difficult to find or understand.
Don’t clear the password after an error unless there is a clear security reason.
Don’t use a password field for information that isn’t secret.

passwordVisible.text: the user has shown or hidden the password with the eye toggle.
passwordVisible.source: Figma 95:596 (InputField/PasswordField component-set description › state, item 1 "passwordVisible / passwordInvisible")

passwordInvisible.text: the user has shown or hidden the password with the eye toggle.
passwordInvisible.source: Figma 95:596 (InputField/PasswordField component-set description › state, item 1 "passwordVisible / passwordInvisible")

errorVisible.text: validation failed, with the password shown or hidden. Always show an error message with it.
errorVisible.source: Figma 95:596 (InputField/PasswordField component-set description › state, item 2 "errorVisible / errorInvisible")

errorInvisible.text: validation failed, with the password shown or hidden. Always show an error message with it.
errorInvisible.source: Figma 95:596 (InputField/PasswordField component-set description › state, item 2 "errorVisible / errorInvisible")

disable.text: the field can’t be edited right now.

a11y.text: The label is a native <label> tied to the input’s id.
The input is type="password" while hidden and type="text" while shown.
The show/hide toggle’s aria-label is "Show <labelText>", and its aria-pressed is true while the password is shown.
The show/hide toggle is in the tab order.
state="disable" sets disabled on the input.
The error states ("errorVisible", "errorInvisible") set aria-invalid on the input.
